prompt: A game stores a character's facing direction as $\cos\theta = 0.6$, with $\theta$ in Quadrant 1. To move the character, the game needs $\sin\theta$. What is $\sin\theta$?

hints.text: $\sqrt{0.64} = 0.8$. In Quadrant 1 sine is positive, so $\sin\theta = 0.8$.

explanation: The identity $\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1$ links the two values, so knowing one gives the other.
Take the square root: $\sin\theta = 0.8$. Quadrant 1 is up-and-right, where sine is positive, so keep the plus.

alternativeExplanations.title: Spot the 3-4-5 triangle
steps: cos θ = 0.6 = 3/5 means the across leg is 3 and the slanted side is 5.
That is the famous 3-4-5 right triangle, so the up leg is 4. sin θ = 4/5 = 0.8.

alternativeExplanations.title: Check the game math
steps: A facing direction must be a point on the unit circle, so across² + up² has to equal 1.
Test 0.8: 0.6² + 0.8² = 0.36 + 0.64 = 1. It checks out, so 0.8 is the value the game needs.
